metadata.title: Cinematic Portrait with High-Contrast Chiaroscuro and Wide Sans-Serif

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast profile portrait featuring dramatic side-lighting, wind-swept hair, and a bold, widely-spaced geometric sans-serif title at the base.
triggerTerms: dramatic profile portrait with black background
excludeWhen: soft, low-contrast pastel aesthetics are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up profile of a woman with vibrant auburn hair, eyes closed in a serene expression, illuminated by a sharp light source against a deep black void. The lower third features a sequined garment and a clean, white, uppercase typographic block.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast light fall-off between the face and the black background
Dynamic movement of hair strands contrasting with the static pose
Horizontal typographic anchor balancing the verticality of the profile
Texture contrast between smooth skin and reflective sequins
coreInvariants: Deep black negative space surrounding the subject
Warm-toned directional lighting on the face and hair
Wide letter-spacing in the display typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the upper two-thirds, angled diagonally from the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightly lit face and the white text at the bottom serve as primary anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the curve of the neck up to the face, then follows the flow of the hair down to the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space occupies the top and right edges, creating a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with saturated warm tones in the hair against a zero-value background.

composition.overlap: Overlays the bottom of the subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact and clarity.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, modern geometric structure.
Provides the necessary geometric 'O' and sharp apexes.
A widely available alternative with similar proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast profile portrait of a woman with auburn hair against a black background, lit from the side to create deep shadows. The bottom edge should feature a textured sequined fabric.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text in white at the bottom center, using extremely wide tracking so the letters span the width of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered and widely spaced?
Is the lighting on the face dramatic and directional?
Are the letters clean, white, and sans-serif?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or logos
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the facial profile

postGenerationChecks: Check that hair strands do not obscure the legibility of the letters
Verify the 'O' is a perfect circle
Confirm the background is free of noise or gradients
recipe.reuseFormula: Dramatic Profile + Chiaroscuro Lighting + Wide-Tracked Geometric Sans-Serif
